# ADHD Reset Planner — Start Here 🌿

A gentle, guilt-free digital planner with working hyperlinks, energy-based
task suggestions, and draggable habit stamps. Built for GoodNotes & Notability
on iPad (also works in Xodo and most PDF annotation apps).

> **The whole idea:** near-zero setup, tap-to-navigate, and not one red X or
> broken-streak guilt anywhere. Use it on the days you can. Rest counts too.

---

## 📦 What's in this download

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `ADHD-Reset-Planner-Light.pdf` | The main planner — cream/light theme (recommended) |
| `ADHD-Reset-Planner-Dark.pdf` | Same planner, dark theme (easier on some eyes at night) |
| `stickers/good-stamp.png` | "GOOD" habit stamp (green) — draggable |
| `stickers/okay-stamp.png` | "it's okay" habit stamp (lavender) — draggable |
| `stickers/good-dot.png` · `okay-dot.png` | Compact "GOOD" / "okay" stamps (colour + label) sized for tracker cells |
| `stickers/sticker-sheet.pdf` | All stamps on one page (for lasso-copy inside your app) |
| `README.md` (this file) | Start-here guide + FAQ |

Pick **one** planner file (Light *or* Dark) to import — you don't need both.

---

## 🚀 60-second quick start

1. Download and **unzip** this folder on your iPad (Files app → tap the .zip).
2. Open **GoodNotes** (or Notability / Xodo).
3. **Import** `ADHD-Reset-Planner-Light.pdf` as a **document** (not "as image").
4. Open it and tap the **top navigation bar** — you should jump between pages.
   That's it. You're set up.
5. (Optional) Add the sticker PNGs to your sticker library — see below.

There is **no complicated setup**, no account, no template stitching. If a tap
jumps you to the right page, everything is working.

---

## 📥 How to import (per app)

### GoodNotes 5 / 6
1. Open GoodNotes → **New** (or the **+** button) → **Import**.
2. Choose the planner PDF from Files/iCloud/Downloads.
3. It opens as a notebook. Tabs and links are tappable immediately.

*Alternative:* in the Files app, long-press the PDF → **Share** → **GoodNotes**.

### Notability
1. Open Notability → tap the **Import** icon (or **+** → **Import**).
2. Select the planner PDF → it imports as a note.
3. Make sure you're on a recent version (internal links need Notability 11+).

### Xodo
1. Open Xodo → **+** / Open → pick the planner PDF.
2. Links work in **View** mode. If a tap doesn't jump, exit annotate/edit mode
   (tap the pencil off) and try again.

> Any PDF app that supports **internal document links** will work. The links are
> standard PDF "go-to page" links — nothing app-specific or proprietary.

---

## 🧭 How the navigation works

- **Top nav bar** (on every page): **Home · Check-In · Brain Dump · To-Do · Tasks.**
  Tap a tab to jump to that section from anywhere.
- **Energy → tasks:** on the Check-In page, tap *"tap for full Low / High Energy
  Bank"* to jump to the matching task list. This is the energy-based flow — pick
  tasks that match the energy you actually have today.
- **Gentle loop:** the small note at the top of the Check-In page (*"come back to
  page one"*) links to the Mindset page for the hard days.
- **"Why am I putting this off?"** links each reason to the tool that helps
  (e.g. *too big → Task Breakdown*, *no energy → Low Energy Bank*).

---

## 🎨 Using the habit stickers

You have two ways to use them — pick whichever your app supports best.

**Option A — drag from Files (works in GoodNotes):**
1. In GoodNotes, open the **image/sticker** tool (the sticker or photo icon).
2. Add `good-stamp.png` and `okay-stamp.png` (and the dots) to a sticker
   collection, or drag them straight from the **Files** app onto the page.
3. Drop a stamp on any Habit Tracker cell. Resize with the corner handles.

**Option B — lasso-copy from the sticker sheet (works everywhere):**
1. Import `stickers/sticker-sheet.pdf` (or keep it as a page).
2. Use the **Lasso** tool to circle a stamp → **Copy** → **Paste** onto your
   tracker.

The stamps are transparent PNGs, so they sit cleanly on the page with no white box.
**GOOD** (green) = did it. **it's okay** (lavender) = didn't, and that's fine.

---

## 🔁 Reusing pages (daily / weekly)

This is a **template set** — one of each page. To reuse a page (e.g. a fresh
Check-In each day), **duplicate** it inside your app:

- **GoodNotes:** tap the **thumbnail/grid** icon (top-left) → tap **⋯** on the
  page you want → **Duplicate Page** → drag it where you want it.
- **Notability:** open the **page thumbnails** (top-left) → tap **⋯** / long-press
  a page → **Duplicate**.
- **Xodo:** open the **page thumbnail** panel → long-press a page → **Duplicate**.

Tip: duplicate a few blank Check-In / Brain Dump pages at the start of each week
so they're ready when you are. (No pressure to fill them all — that's the point.)

## ❓ FAQ & troubleshooting

**Q: In GoodNotes, I have to long-press and tap "Open Link" instead of just
tapping — is that normal?**
Yes — that's expected GoodNotes behavior, not a broken link. GoodNotes has two
modes:
- **Edit mode** (default): links need a long-press, then tap **"Open Link"** —
  this prevents accidental jumps while you're writing.
- **Read-Only mode**: a single light tap jumps instantly, no popup.

To switch: tap the **pencil icon in the top-right corner** of GoodNotes to enter
Read-Only mode. Use this mode whenever you just want to navigate without writing
on the page.

**Q: The links / nav bar won't jump when I tap. What do I do?**
Work down this list — one of these fixes it almost every time:
1. **Import as a document, not an image.** "Import as image" flattens the links.
   Re-import and choose the PDF/document option.
2. **Update your app.** Older Notability (pre-11) and very old PDF apps don't
   support internal links. Update to the latest version.
3. **Turn off your pen/eraser first.** If a drawing tool is active, a tap may
   draw a dot instead of following the link. Switch to the **Hand / Pointer /
   selection** tool, then tap the link.
4. **Tap right on the label or tab.** Link zones sit on the text/tab. Zoom in a
   little and tap directly on it.
5. **Don't "flatten" or "print to PDF"** the file — that can strip the links.
6. Still stuck? Message me — include your app name + version and I'll help.

**Q: Do I need both the Light and Dark files?**
No. Import whichever you prefer. Many people keep Light for daytime and Dark for
night — totally optional.

**Q: Can I use this on Android / a Windows tablet / GoodNotes for Mac?**
Yes. Any PDF app with internal-link support works (Xodo is a great free
cross-platform option). The links are standard PDF links.

**Q: There's only one of each page — is that a mistake?**
No. It's a lightweight template set, on purpose (fast import, no clutter).
**Duplicate** the pages you want to reuse — see "Reusing pages" above.

**Q: Can I print it?**
It's designed for digital use (the hyperlinks are the whole point), but the
pages print fine if you want a paper Check-In or Brain Dump.

**Q: Why are there no streaks / red marks / X's?**
By design. Missing a day isn't a failure here — blank days just stay blank, and
the habit stamps are "GOOD" or "it's okay," never "bad." Rest counts too.

**Q: The stickers show a white square behind them.**
Use the **PNG** files (they're transparent). If you copied from a screenshot or
converted them, the transparency can get lost — use the originals in `stickers/`.

## 💛 A note on how to use this

You don't have to use every page, every day. Open it on the days you can. Skip
the parts that don't help. The planner is a small guide for getting back up —
not another thing to be perfect at.
